scripts.worker: cd worker && uv run uvicorn app:app --port 8787
scripts.db: docker start cp-trainer-pg 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name cp-trainer-pg -e POSTGRES_USER=cp -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=cp -e POSTGRES_DB=cp_trainer -p 5488:5432 -v cp-trainer-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine
scripts.db:schema: docker exec -i cp-trainer-pg psql -U cp -d cp_trainer < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:migrate: for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do echo "-- $f"; docker exec -i cp-trainer-pg psql -U cp -d cp_trainer -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.seed: cd worker && uv run python seed_usaco.py && uv run python seed_cf.py
scripts.seed:icpc: cd worker && uv run python seed_icpc.py
